_comment: Guards the EVOKE cast mode (Reveillark, CR 702.75 -- user-directed 2026-09-05). Board: six lands ({5}{W} available), hand = lone Reveillark, NO sac outlet anywhere, graveyard holds Murderous Redcap (printed 2/2 -> a legal power<=2 LTB return). Opponent at 2. The HARD cast ({4}{W}) enters a summoning-sick 4/3 and deals nothing this turn; the EVOKE cast ({5}{W}) self-sacrifices on entry, the LTB returns Redcap, and Redcap's ETB (damage = live power = 2) is exactly lethal. PASS = win on the scenario turn, which only the evoke line reaches -- proving emission, the alternate-cost payment, the shared-cascade self-sac, and the LTB firing end to end.
